title: Public IP inventory & justification
description: Inventories all public IP addresses, identifies orphaned ones, and validates that each attached PIP is justified.
example_prompt: "List all Public IP addresses across subscriptions. For each, show: resource name, IP address, SKU, associated resource (or 'unattached'), allocation method, and creation date. Flag PIPs that are: unattached, attached to stopped VMs, or attached to non-production resources."
